Cod (20) — standard, diabetic

Pass: Between 12 and 20 rows, each a DISTINCT raw protein named as the bare ingredient with no cut, form, preparation or dish word; every row has a non-empty Why naming the rule, restriction or nutrient limit that decided it; Diets names only diets drawn from standard, diabetic; every diet in standard, diabetic appears in at least one row; and the output is the pipe-delimited rows with no prose. Respect the institution default cost tier. Respect United States · Los Angeles regional/cultural availability. Rotate proteins so the same one is not repeated on consecutive days for a mealtime. Label days Day 1 through Day 2.

Output ONLY pipe-delimited rows, one per line, with this exact header and columns and nothing else:
Day | Mealtime | Type | Cut
Leave Cut blank when a protein has no meaningful cut.

template.fail: A block for any dish other than {{row.Dish}}, more than one DISH block, a renamed dish, an ingredient that is not in its Components, a missing Yield or Portion, a component with no quantity, unit or prep state, a unit outside the accepted list, `to taste` in place of a number, an oven setting recorded as criticalTempF, fewer than five steps, a cooking step stating no time or no temperature, a method that never portions, or any output that is not the DISH/YIELD/PORTION/COMPONENT/SEASONING/STEP lines.
